science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
text: The Basalt Spire Ridge roared under the unrelenting force of the ferrofluid sea, where the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear sought to unspool the very atmosphere. Hector balanced precariously on the slick precipice, his boots seeking purchase as he recalibrated the heavy brass induction coil to repel the shrieking ionization fog. Above him, jagged metallic waves crashed in a mesmerizing frenzy, throwing out volatile arcs of static that left a sharp tang lingering against the bitter cold. He forcefully slammed the humming copper calibration baton directly into Kaio's waiting grip, shouting a frantic warning over the deafening gale.
